summary: Login form does not render visible error message when authentication fails with invalid credentials
expected: Clear user-friendly error banner or alert displayed upon receiving HTTP 401 Unauthorized
actual: Form catches error silently without displaying visual feedback banner to user
rootCause: Error state in LoginForm component is not bound to a visible alert banner or toast component
recommendedFix: Bind caught 401 error response message to an error state and render a visible alert banner above submit button

summary: Flyway migration V23 contains PostgreSQL-specific partial index syntax incompatible with H2 local development database
expected: Flyway migrations run cleanly against both PostgreSQL and H2 local development database
actual: Flyway throws SyntaxError on 'CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ... WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING', 'SETTLED')'
rootCause: PostgreSQL partial index syntax 'WHERE clause' is not natively supported in H2 2.x standard grammar
recommendedFix: Use database-agnostic index definitions or provide separate Flyway vendor migration directory for H2/PostgreSQL

summary: Duplicate /api/api/ prefix generated by b2b.service.ts and admin pages when calling backend endpoints
actual: Axios concatenates baseURL (/api) with path (/api/v1/...) resulting in http://localhost:8080/api/api/v1/...
rootCause: frontend/lib/api.ts sets baseURL with /api suffix, while b2b.service.ts paths also include /api prefix
recommendedFix: Strip leading /api from endpoint paths in b2b.service.ts (e.g. use /v1/organizations instead of /api/v1/organizations)

summary: Finance portal pages call non-existent endpoints /finance/dashboard and /finance/transactions
expected: Finance dashboard retrieves summary and transaction history from valid backend endpoints
rootCause: Frontend service day6.service.ts calls legacy stub paths; backend implements /api/v1/finance/summary, /api/v1/finance/ledger, and /api/finance/projects
recommendedFix: Refactor day6.service.ts and finance pages to consume /api/v1/finance/summary and /api/finance/projects

summary: Penny drop verification endpoint mismatch between frontend service and backend controller
actual: Frontend calls POST /api/v1/bank-accounts/${bankAccountId}/verify-penny-drop which does not exist
rootCause: b2b.service.ts method verifyPennyDrop was authored against an assumed route rather than OrganizationController
recommendedFix: Update b2b.service.ts verifyPennyDrop to invoke OrganizationController endpoint with orgId and accountId

summary: ESLint fails with 462 problems due to unignored build artifact directory .next-test
expected: npm run lint runs cleanly against project source code
actual: ESLint scans compiled Turbopack chunks in .next-test/ causing 334 errors and 128 warnings
rootCause: eslint.config.mjs ignores .next/** but omitted .next-test/** and other test output directories
recommendedFix: Add .next-test/** and test-artifacts/** to global ignores in eslint.config.mjs

summary: API client forces hardcoded Render backend URL during server-side execution
expected: getApiBaseUrl respects local environment configuration during both SSR and CSR
actual: When typeof window === 'undefined', baseURL is hardcoded to https://finx-backend-vq5b.onrender.com/api
rootCause: frontend/lib/api.ts lines 36-40 override localhost configuration with Render production domain during SSR
recommendedFix: Allow NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL or process.env.INTERNAL_API_URL to take precedence in SSR context

summary: Hardcoded Render production backend URL in Google OAuth service fallback
expected: Google OAuth configuration fetched dynamically from configured local or production API base
actual: auth.service.ts line 65 falls back directly to https://finx-backend-vq5b.onrender.com/api/auth/google/config
rootCause: Direct hardcoded fetch URL in auth.service.ts instead of utilizing dynamic api client instance
recommendedFix: Use api.get('/auth/google/config') with standard client base resolution

summary: Public blockchain explorer triggers unauthenticated requests to protected endpoints /api/notifications and /api/deals
expected: Public routes load without emitting 401 Unauthorized API requests
actual: Header and dashboard subcomponents fire authenticated API requests without checking authentication status
rootCause: Components trigger data fetching hooks unconditionally on mount without verifying session presence
recommendedFix: Add conditional check (!user || !token) before triggering authenticated notification and deal queries

summary: Direct settlement payout endpoint explicitly disabled on backend while frontend still retains trigger button
expected: Frontend reflects certified ReleaseExecutionPlatform operations instead of legacy direct settlement
actual: POST /api/v1/settlements/authorize throws AccessDeniedException 'Settlement payout execution is disabled'
rootCause: Backend migrated settlement execution to AdminReleaseManagementController; legacy endpoint was disabled
recommendedFix: Bind admin settlements UI to /api/v1/finance/release-operations endpoints instead of legacy authorize endpoint

summary: Settlement lookup endpoints by settlementId and milestoneId missing from backend controller
expected: Settlements queryable by dealId, settlementId, or milestoneId
recommendedFix: Update PaymentOrchestrationController to support single settlement lookup by id and milestoneId

summary: Suspend Identity buttons rendered in user table without attached click handlers
expected: Clicking Suspend Identity prompts confirmation and calls user suspension API
actual: Buttons are inert with no attached onClick handler
rootCause: Table action column rendered static buttons without binding to mutation callback
recommendedFix: Implement handleSuspendUser handler calling AdminController user status update endpoint

summary: Launch Escrow Command and View Audit History buttons on Admin overview lack operational handlers
expected: Buttons trigger escrow action modal or navigate to /admin/audit-logs
actual: Buttons render with no onClick or href attributes
rootCause: Placeholder action buttons in Quick Actions card
recommendedFix: Wrap Launch Escrow Command with link to /admin/deals and View Audit History with link to /admin/audit-logs

summary: Sign Out button in admin deals page header is not wired to auth logout handler
expected: Clicking Sign Out terminates user session and redirects to /login
actual: Button does not invoke logout handler
rootCause: Header component renders secondary sign out button without calling useAuth().logout()
recommendedFix: Connect Sign Out button to authService.logout() or router.push('/login')

summary: Nested interactive elements: button tags wrapped inside anchor/Link tags on landing page
expected: Valid semantic HTML without nested interactive elements (button inside a)
actual: creates nested interactive elements
rootCause: Button component used inside HTML anchor tags instead of styling anchor directly or using asChild
recommendedFix: Use Next.js Link with className button styling or Button asChild pattern without nested button tag

summary: Registration form lacks interactive role selector to choose between Buyer, Seller, and Project Manager
expected: User can select intended platform role during sign up
actual: Form submits default payload without exposing role options to user
rootCause: Registration form design omitted role selector dropdown or radio group
recommendedFix: Add role selector (BUYER, SELLER, PROJECT_MANAGER) in RegisterForm component
